page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8y.large is an Arm-based memory-optimized instance powered by the proprietary Alibaba YiTian710 processor. The system provides 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs at a nominal clock speed of 2.75 GHz, using a 1-thread-per-core configuration. Memory capacity is set at 16.0 GB, yielding a high ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Cache configuration includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 64 MB L3 cache. It operates on the KVM hypervisor with hardware AES encryption enabled, lacks integrated GPUs, includes no local storage, and provides a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate balanced single-threaded execution alongside constrained multi-core throughput typical of a 2-vCPU envelope. In synthetic evaluations, stress-ng single-core performance reached 1819.49 and Geekbench single-core scored 1399.0, both placing in the average tier. Conversely, multi-threaded metrics such as stress-ng multi-core (3596.97) and PassMark CPU score (1725.22) fall into lower percentiles due to core limitations. Memory throughput measures 203.35 GB/sec for small cached reads, 25.82 GB/sec for large uncached reads, and 13.63 GB/sec for large uncached writes, accompanied by a PassMark memory score of 1879.92.

The primary efficiency tradeoff of ecs.r8y.large lies in its high memory-to-vCPU allocation on Arm architecture, minimizing compute overhead for memory-bound tasks. Workload benchmarks reflect this balance: Redis SET operations deliver 3.19 million operations per second, while static web serving achieves 3.23 GB/sec. Compute-heavy operations like Clang compilation (3148.0) and ray tracing (2377.0) score lower, making this instance best matched for in-memory caches, small relational database instances, intermediate queue workers, and memory-intensive lightweight services that do not require heavy parallel computing or local NVMe scratch space.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8y.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs on the 2.75 GHz Alibaba YiTian710 arm64 processor paired with 16.0 GB of RAM. Delivering an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio, it includes a 64 MB L3 cache, hardware AES acceleration, a 2 Gbps baseline network interface, zero bundled local storage, and no GPU hardware. Performance metrics indicate solid single-thread performance, evidenced by a 1399.0 Geekbench single-core score and 1819.49 stress-ng score, while overall parallel processing is capped by its two-core design. Memory subsystem testing reflects 25.82 GB/sec for large block uncached reads and up to 3.19 million Redis SET operations per second. Lacking local NVMe disks, ecs.r8y.large suits memory-dependent, low-to-moderate compute applications such as in-memory data caching, lightweight database deployments, and message queue management.
